projectDescription: A stdlib-only Python client for the Meawfy file-index API that validates all 50 query parameters, handles rate limiting and paging, and surfaces the endpoint's silent failure modes as typed exceptions.
keyFeatures: Validates all 50 endpoint parameters before any network call, raising typed errors instead of silently sending malformed requests
Sliding-window rate limiter that paces at 120 req/min, honours Retry-After, and exposes remaining capacity
Multi-page helpers (iterate, collect) that stop safely at the undocumented 10,000-row window
Echo-report comparison that detects parameters the index silently dropped (the handbook's primary debugging tool)
verify() and diff() helpers for two-call parameter auditing and cross-drive content comparison
Replay transport and fixture system for pinning a tested response against an unversioned endpoint
Eight recipes (R7–R14) from The Query Handbook as first-class callable objects
Full CLI (python -m meawfy) with flags for every parameter, plus dedicated commands for recipes, verification, diff, and dead-row sweeps
Zero dependencies — standard library only (urllib, argparse)
publicApiSurface: MeawfyError / InvalidParameter / UnknownParameter / DeepPagingError / ResponseError / RateLimited / TransportError
PARAMS / LOAD_BEARING / CAPS / PROVIDERS / KNOWN_PROVIDERS / EXPERIMENTAL_PROVIDERS
